item.title: $63M housing complex in Tampa delivers nearly 400 affordable units
item.description: A new affordable housing apartment complex officially opened Thursday in Tampa’s West River district, bringing 384 new affordable homes to the area. Related Urban Development Group, the affordable housing arm of Miami-based real estate company Related Group, joined the Tampa Housing Authority Thursday to hold a ribbon cutting ceremony for Canopy at West River, a four-tower development broken into two developments, one at 1350 W. item.title: Fort Myers medical office building sells for $4.6 million
item.description: The Gladiolus Surgery Center, a medical office building in Fort Myers, has sold.The 7,315-square-foot building was bought by the suburban Dallas real estate investment firm Prime Healthcare Properties. item.title: Sarasota fertility company closes $760K clinic acquisition deal
item.description: A Sarasota fertility company has closed on the acquisition of a Midwest fertility clinic. Invo Fertility Inc. (Nasdaq: IVF) has acquired the nonclinical assets of Indianapolis-based Family Beginnings in a $760,000 deal consisting of cash and preferred stock consideration. item.title: El Greco to return in south Sarasota
item.description: A Greek eatery that served downtown Sarasota under its original owners for nearly 20 years is reopening in South Sarasota location in the coming months. El Greco Kitchen & Market will be located at 4035 Clark Road in the Expo shopping center near the Sawyer Road intersection. item.title: Medical office building in Lakewood Ranch sells for $3.6M
item.description: A fully occupied medical office building recently sold in Lakewood Ranch. Sina Holdings II LLC purchased the property at 8614 State Road 70 E. for $3.6 million, according to SVN Commercial Advisory Group, which brokered the deal.The 14,400-square-foot building is within the Ranch Lake office and retail complex just east of Interstate 75. item.title: Fort Myers portfolio sells for $30 million
item.description: A New Jersey real estate investment firm has paid $30 million for an industrial flex portfolio in Fort Myers.The properties are at 6150-6481 Metro Plex Drive and total 218,000 square feet.Lee County property records show the buyer is an LLC with an address matching that of B&D Holding, a Warren, New Jersey privately held investment and development firm specializing in industrial properties. item.title: Retired attorney, family donate $10M to Naples hospital
item.description: The Coletti family in Collier County has given $10 million to Naples Comprehensive Health to advance oncology services for women at the hospital. The gift is in honor of the life and legacy of Brynne Coletti, who died in December 2024 from brain cancer at 67. NCH will recognize this gift through the naming of the Bob and Brynne Coletti Women’s Cancer Program, according to a statement. item.title: Report: Florida ranks No. 2 in statewide foreclosure pressure
